summary: A10 Networks filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, reporting Q3 results (quarter ended September 30, 2026) via press release and posted website slides under Items 2.02/7.01, alongside an Item 8.01 announcement that its Board of Directors approved a quarterly dividend of $0.06 per share. The dividend is payable December 1, 2026 to holders of record November 16, 2026, subject to possible prior revocation. No advisor or recommendation beyond Board approval is named. The Board retains discretion to adjust or withdraw future dividends as it reviews capital allocation; watch payout sustainability and any shift toward larger capital-return actions.
